cases.title: Discard password after selecting Never For This Site
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available choices for multiple saved usernames and passwords
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Update saved password when changed
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and the password is later changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Verify password manager disabled behavior
cases.description: Verify that when password manager from the preferences panel is disabled, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in preferences panel
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be viewed in the password manager through the preferences.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are removed for a given site, they no longer autofill on that site and are no longer listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill on sites and nothing being listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: The test cases are well-aligned with the requirements, distinct, and adequately test the specified functionality without speculative or redundant cases.
All test cases map correctly to the given requirements and thoroughly cover the specified operations without any blockers, speculative behaviors, or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-102: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including discarding the password after selection, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-103: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including saving multiple usernames/passwords and making them available, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-104: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including saving credentials and picking up the changed password, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-105: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including disabling the password manager, suppressing save prompts, and suppressing prefilled info, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-106: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including saving credentials and viewing them in the preferences panel, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-107: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including removing specific credentials, stopping autofill for that site, and unlisting them from the password manager, warranting a Normal test scenario. Requirement R-108: Describes multiple distinct behaviors including removing all credentials, stopping all autofill, and clearing the password manager list, warranting a Normal test scenario.
